title: Base rate for management promise delivery in US mid-cap industrials (WTS, AOS, SSD, LECO; Nov 2026)
body: Same-method promise scores for four US mid-cap industrial / building-products companies (last 6 earnings calls each, Jul-2025 to Nov-2026; Motley Fool transcripts, 8-K Ex 99.1 press releases where no transcript was found: WTS Q3-25, SSD Q2-26, LECO Q2-25 and Q2-26). Weighted delivery (credit, specificity-weighted): US-WTS 100.0% (n=12), US-AOS 65.9% (n=18), US-SSD 79.4% (n=7), US-LECO 88.5% (n=6). Sector pattern: explicit company-level margin and growth ranges are met or beaten (pooled margin 92.9%, revenue/growth 70.7%), because US managements guide conservatively and raise; misses cluster in China / international sub-lines (A. O. Smith), capex forecasts and plant ramps (pooled capacity 50.0%). A. O. Smith cut its FY2026 guide three times (Jan-26 items score withdrawn). Most FY2026 guidance is pending and n is small (6-18 scored per company). SAC (pts vs leave-one-out peer medians): US-WTS +15.3, US-AOS -35.3, US-SSD -7.0, US-LECO -11.5. Use: base rates for credibility-generated paper calls (thesis tags credibility-generated, us). Provisional. Research, not advice.
